claim: Bodegas Benjamin de Rothschild & Vega Sicilia (Macán) es el proyecto conjunto, con sede en Samaniego (La Rioja), de estas dos familias [los Rothschild y la de Vega Sicilia] tan ligadas al mundo del vino.
label: PARTIALLY_TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Split (part 2 of 2). The joint venture holds: Macán was founded in 2004 by Benjamin de Rothschild and Pablo Álvarez, president of Vega Sicilia (Macán's own site). The location detail does not: Samaniego is in Álava (Basque Country) - the winery's address is 01307 Samaniego, Álava - in the Rioja Alavesa part of the Rioja appellation, not in La Rioja. Borderline: '(La Rioja)' for the wine region is common usage (OKDiario does the same).
